description: The most recent Zcash blocks. When to use: checking whether ZEC is producing blocks normally and at what interval. Do not use: for shielded-pool supply (that is zec_get_pool_status). Returns: for the last N blocks (default 5, max 20): height, hash, time, difficulty.

n.description: How many recent blocks to return; default 5

name: zec_get_recent_blocks
